comparison.objective: Break emergency glass and pull a fire-alarm handle when a visible fire justifies it; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Alarm operation tests deliberate breakage and handle pulling. Candidate tests precision tool engagement, fine adjustment, locking, and damage-avoiding dynamic validation.
comparison.success_condition: Glass must be smashed and the handle pulled fully; candidate explicitly fails on damage or hard-stop impact and must meet repeatable stopping thresholds.
comparison.reason: Emergency destructive action and careful mechanical commissioning are opposing, unrelated outcomes.
